# Dot & Dash Sensory

> Dot & Dash Sensory makes high-contrast visual stimulation videos for babies
> 0-6 months, built on measured contrast, pattern and motion research.

Independent producer of high-contrast baby sensory video. Unusually for the
category, the full production specification is published: target contrast
ratio, pattern spatial frequency, motion speed, temporal frequency and scene
duration, broken out by age band from 0 to 6 months.

## Pages

- [Methodology](https://dotanddashsensory.com/methodology.html): the full
  published specification, the age-band table, and the primary research each
  threshold is drawn from.
- [Home](https://dotanddashsensory.com/): overview and parent questions.

## Position

Makes no developmental claims. Paediatric guidance is cautious about screen
use under two years; the specification describes what is on screen for parents
who choose to use it.
